    Weights of mesh corrections (Proposition 7.6, weights) #

    "a mesh weight w grades V_{m+1}(C) by giving a path at row v the weight w(path) − ν_v, and grades U_m(C) by giving a path parallel to an arrow a the weight w(path) − w(a). The map D_m preserves these gradings, because each term (σa)a of the mesh at v has weight ν_v. Hence coker D_m is graded".

    mfProj χ, afProj χ are the relative weight-χ projections of mesh and arrow families; D_m commutes with them (meshDerivative_afProj), so they descend to the cokernel (cokerProj). Consequently, when the rows of S span the cokernels, a family of relative weight χ lies in the span of the rows of S of relative weight χ (mem_rowSpan_char), and so does the class Ψ[μ] of a cocycle of character χ (Ψc_mem_rowSpan_char).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
